issues.title: Bottom padding clipping
issues.description: The last item lacks bottom container padding and touches the bottom card border.
issues.evidence: The 'Full color' row is flush against the bottom border of the search container.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent bottom padding inside the command list container.
issues.triageNote: Real component-side defect (verified by pixel-probing the audit screenshot: the last row was hard-sliced mid-glyph flush against the card's bottom border; a plain pb-* scrolls away with content and provably changed nothing — byte-identical screenshot). Fixed with a sticky bottom edge fade (MessageScroller pattern) that dissolves rows running past the scroll edge and guarantees a resting inset. Post-fix re-audit: the padding/slice defect is gone; the remaining 'partial last row' is imposed by the eval page allocating the card less height than its content at 320x480 (flex-1 min-h-0, no-scroll constraint) — that residual clipping is composition-level and cannot be removed from the component without overflowing the page.

issues.title: Misaligned keyboard shortcuts in RTL
issues.description: Command item shortcuts and search elements exhibit improper LTR placement.
issues.evidence: Shortcut keys (e.g., 1 ⌘) sit on the left edge while item text is right-aligned.
issues.suggestion: Adjust flex layout and BiDi properties for command item slot positioning.
issues.triageNote: Real defect in RTL: physical ml-auto pinned the shortcut next to the item text instead of the row's end, and the RTL paragraph reordered '⌘1' into '1 ⌘'. Fixed with logical ms-auto (shortcut pinned to the inline-end edge) plus unicode-bidi:plaintext isolation so keycaps render '⌘1' LTR (verified via per-character client rects).

issues.title: LTR string truncation defect in RTL layout
issues.description: Mixed-direction folder names truncate awkwardly at the start of LTR strings instead of using end-truncation.
issues.evidence: Ellipsis appears at the start of '...d_Guidelines_and_Identity_System_01' and '... Q4 Product Shoot'.
issues.suggestion: Enforce consistent text direction isolation and proper text-overflow truncation for mixed-directional labels.
issues.triageNote: Real defect in RTL: English filenames inherited the RTL base direction, so overflow truncation cut the leading end and produced a leading ellipsis. Fixed by first-strong (unicode-bidi:plaintext) bidi isolation on command-item content — LTR filenames now start-truncate with a trailing ellipsis (verified via per-character client rects).
